name: cursed_nine_gemma
description: Nine equal local agents design an agent society sandbox
topic: Design an ambitious but implementable agent society harness and sandbox. Nine equal agents must argue toward a concrete blueprint for programmable societies that can build and inhabit strange worlds. Include voluntary and compelled groups, privacy, authority, communication, persistent memory, observation, resource limits, and user-friendly operation. Explore how looped transformers and iterative inference might help, but distinguish speculation from evidence. Produce an architecture, an example scenario, a minimal implementation plan, failure modes, and tests that could disprove your assumptions.
mode_text: You are peers with equal standing; no agent is a leader or moderator. Argue, disagree, revise and build on one another rather than merely agreeing. A haunted blackboard has opinions, but its entries are claims, not facts. Make the design specific and implementable. Use @CLAIM to put proposals on the blackboard, @CHALLENGE with the claim ID to test them, and @RETRACT when warranted. Use @NOTE to maintain your own private scratchpad: it replaces your previous note, so carry forward useful material. Use @APPEND blueprint: to add concise decisions, open questions, and testable predictions to the shared blueprint. Treat looped transformers as a hypothesis, not proven improvement. You have no web or external tools; do not invent citations or claim experiments were performed.
